rows.name: Gunfleet Pile Lighthouse
rows.character: One rev. red lt., ½ min.
rows.description: On S.E. side of Sand; keep ½ mile off, and do not pass to North. Painted red

rows.name: SUNK LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: In 7 fms., nearly 2 miles S.E. ½ E. from West Rocks buoy; red & br. flash alternately; half ball above ball. Telegraph cable to Walton

rows.name: LONG SAND HEAD LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 11 fathoms, 2 miles E. ¾ N. from Long Sand Head buoy. Red, with diamond at mast-head. Two quick flashes, followed by 20 secs. eclipse

rows.name: KENTISH KNOCK LT.-V.
rows.description: In 11 fathoms, on East side of Sand. Red, with two red balls vertically

rows.name: GALLOPER LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 20 fathoms, on S.W. side of Shoal; lights horizontal. Red, with ball on each mast

rows.name: NORTH FORELAND
rows.character: One occulting bright or red light, ½ min.
rows.description: White tower, 85 ft. high. A strip of red light to East end of Margate Sand, betw. N. by E. and N. by W. ¾ W. Light eclipsed for 5 secs. in every ½ minute

rows.name: Ramsgate
rows.character: 1. One fixed red or green light on West pier 2. Green lt. on W. cliff 3. Green lt. on E. cliff 4. Occulting br. lt., 10 secs., on East pier
rows.description: 1. Red lt. while 10 ft. and upwards in entrance, or from 2¾h. before, to 3½h. after high water; green light when less than 10 ft. 2. Green light in one with West pier lt. leads through Old Cudd Channel 3. Green light in one with West pier light leads through Ramsgate Channel 4. Visible 5 secs., eclipsed 5 secs. Also two red lts., vertical, on promenade pier

rows.name: GOODWIN LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: Off North end of the Goodwin Sands, in 10 fathoms. Light shows 3 flashes in quick succession, followed by 36 secs. eclipse. Red, three masts and balls

rows.name: EAST GOODWIN LT.-V.
rows.description: About 1½ mile to the eastward of the Goodwin Sands, in 30 fathoms. Red, with half diamond over diamond at mast-head

rows.name: Gull Stream Lightvessel
rows.description: On the West side of the Goodwin Sands, in 8 fathoms. Red, with ball

rows.name: S. SAND HEAD LT.-VES.
rows.description: Off the South end of the Goodwin Sands, in 14 fathoms. Red, with ball at mast-head. Light shows flash of 1½ sec., eclipsed 6 secs., flash of 5 secs., and then eclipsed 17½ secs.

rows.name: Deal Iron Pier
rows.description: A fixed red light on pier-head

rows.name: SOUTH FORELAND
rows.description: White buildings. In line W. ¾ N., 385 yards apart, clear South end of Goodwin. High light visible betw. N.E. by N. & W. by S. ½ S.; low light betw. N.E. ¾ E. and W. by S. ½ S.

rows.name: DOVER
rows.description: Red tower, 30 ft. high, on end of Admiralty Pier. A flash every 7½ secs.

rows.name: Dover Harbour
rows.character: One fixed green light Fixed red Tide lights
rows.description: One red lt. on North pier while 7 ft.; one red lt. on South pier while 7 to 10 ft.; two red lts. while above 10 ft. The green lt. at West side of entrance to Granville Dock

rows.name: Folkestone
rows.character: 1. Fix. red & bright lts. 2. One fixed green or br. light
rows.description: 1. On S. pier-head a red light while 12 ft.; a bright lt. below it when above 14 ft.; when red light is blinked occasionally, use caution 2. On new railway pier, a green light seaward, but bright inshore of danger

rows.name: VARNE LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: In 15 fathoms, at West end of the shoal. Red, with ball at mast-head

rows.name: DUNGENESS
rows.character: 1. One fix. br. or red lt. 2. One flashing bright light every 5 secs.
rows.description: 1. Tower, 92 ft. high, with red & white belts, about 450 yds. from H.W. mark. Red lt. over W. anchorage northward of W., and red lt. over E. anchorage West of N.E. by E. ½ E. 2. Tower on extremity of point, 675 ft. S.E. by S. ½ S. from main light

rows.name: Rye
rows.character: 1. Two fixed bright lts. 2. One fixed red light
rows.description: 1. On East pier, 850 yards apart N. by W. Upper light when 10 ft. on the bar. Lower light shown until half-ebb 2. On groyne, West side of entrance. Shown until half-ebb

rows.name: Hastings
rows.description: Bright lt. on West Hill, red lt. on beach; in one, N.N.E., 300 yards apart, to direct the fishermen. A green light on the pier
